integrity: Spherical area and Gaussian-probability normalization are explicit; all nonstandard equalities proved analytically. Numerical verification is supplementary. No external independent validation has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Exact global optimizer asserted only in dimension three; in higher dimensions only the one-versus-rest normal is considered. Classical solid-angle formulas and concave-order arguments are used. An unindexed older special-case computation may exist.
title: Sharp centroidal cuts of the spherical orthant: exact three-dimensional spectrum and a dimensional law
